item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.1

  • Watchlist Multi-Year History Sync: Unified historical price data resolution between Watchlist and Symbol Detail cards, ensuring accurate 1Y and 3Y performance metrics for Vietnamese stocks and global assets.
  • Self-Healing Cache & Fresh Data Ingestion: Automatically refreshes stale sparkline data points and heals on-disk cache with split-adjusted daily series.
  • Build System Improvements: Dynamically resolves build product paths to ensure seamless developer builds and app packaging.
